chapter: Gene Mayl, Teddy Buckner and the Dixie Flies
title: Choosing the Dixie Flies personnel
summary: Joe picked Mike DeLeigh, Al Morgan, Joe Javen, Warren Smith and Harvey Brooks instead of erratic Jackie Coons.

bands.name: Joe Darensbourg and His Dixie Flies

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Because that was a good band you put together.
Yes, it was. And that's when I started thinking about who would I have in the band. In the meantime, I had met Mike DeLeigh(?), and I liked his playing...
And Al Morgan... I think Al Morgan was... Frank Passley was Al Morgan's cousin, and he recommended me to Al. He had introduced me to Al several...oh, a while
before I knew Al. Jackie Coons(?), the trumpet player, was supposed to be my original trumpet player.
Okay, I know who he is.
But Jackie was such an erratic guy, I says, "No, I'd better get Mike" -- because I liked his playing. And Joe Javen(?).
I'm only saying these names so that...
For "Yellow Dog Blues," the recording, we used a guitar. His name escapes me even. I don't know, since I had that wreck it kind of slowed my vibrations down.
